issues.display_title: [GoThruMedia/GoThru-API-New] Issue #1280: Handle Issue Unexpected Street View Token Deletion Causing Persistent Expiration Errors
issues.main_description_html:
Task Description

Note from Developer

The “reconnect” message appears when the token_id in the database is invalid or the token's scope does not include “streetviewpublish.”

I've searched the entire codebase, and there isn't a single line of code that updates the token_id without the user's knowledge—in other words, there is no process that would invalidate the token_id. As for updating the scope, this cannot be done directly through the code; all changes require user approval.

It’s possible that when connecting a Street View account to Gothru, the “streetviewpublish” scope wasn’t checked.

issues.display_title: [GoThruMedia/gothru-dashboard] Issue #4051: Integrate Review Button at Support Page
issues.main_description_html:
Task Description

Overview

Integrate the Review button on the Support Photographer page (Featured Photographers) so that clicking it opens a modal dialog for reviewing a photographer's request.

Context

This task follows the layout update in #4050 (Slicing Update Layout Support Photographer). The table on the Featured Photographers page has a Review button in the Action column for each photographer entry. Currently the button is not wired to any action.

Tasks

  • Show modal review photographer when Review button is clicked
  • Display photographer details inside the modal (name, subscription, userID, request date, current status)
  • Provide Approve and Deny action buttons inside the modal
  • On Approve → update status to Approved and close modal
  • On Deny → update status to Denied and close modal
  • Show loading state while the action is being processed
  • Show success/error feedback after action is completed
  • Close modal on backdrop click or close button

Expected Behavior

  1. User clicks Review button on a photographer row in the Featured Photographers table
  2. A modal appears with the photographer's detail information
  3. User can choose to Approve or Deny the request
  4. The status in the table updates accordingly after confirmation
  5. Modal closes after action is taken

Design Reference

Refer to the Featured Photographers design in Figma for layout and styling: https://www.figma.com/design/jDH5icFzVdkfYrA2VfQoPe/FInal-GoThru--Dashboard?node-id=5924-95786

docs.rendered_html:
Tours — Preview Tour

GET /tours/preview/{mid}

Auth: middleware('auth')

Flow:

  1. Request enters → PreviewTourController@handle builds PreviewTourDto from user_id (auth) and mid (route param).
  2. Controller delegates to PreviewTourAction::execute(PreviewTourDto).
  3. Action runs business logic:
    • Check if user_id is a super-user (via SUPER_USER env).
    • Check if user owns the moderation record via ToursRepository::checkModerationOwnership() — if not owner and not super-user, throw TOURS.MODERATION_NOT_OWNER.
    • If super-user, fetch the actual owner's user_id via ToursRepository::getModerationInfo() and substitute it.
    • Resolve short URL via PreviewClass::checkShortUrl(), then generate the preview link via PreviewClass::generatePreviewLink().
    • Returns preview URL as a string: https://gothru.co/P{shortUrl}.
  4. Controller receives URL → checks ec request header to decide response shape:
    • ec is null / "" / "true" → ResponseEnvelopeHelper::encryptResult() (encrypted)
    • any other value → ResponseEnvelopeHelper::responseMessages() (plain)
    • ToursDomainException → ToursExceptionHttpMapper::toStatusCode() → responseMessages()
    • \Throwable → statusCodeFromThrowable() → responseMessages()

DTO (app/DTOs/Tours/PreviewTourDto.php):

FieldTypeSourceNotes
user_idint$request->user_idinjected by auth middleware
midintroute param {mid}moderation ID

Response (200) — encrypted (default, ec header null / "" / "true"):

{
  "statusCode": 200,
  "data": {
    "messages": "Preview link generated",
    "cry": "<encrypted payload>",
    "ls": "...",
    "e4": "..."
  }
}

Response (200) — plain (ec header = any other value):

{
  "statusCode": 200,
  "data": {
    "messages": "Preview link generated",
    "url": "https://gothru.co/P<shortUrl>"
  }
}

Payload url = https://gothru.co/P{shortUrl}. Encryption toggled by ec request header at Controller transport edge.

Errors:

domainCodeHTTPCondition
TOURS.MODERATION_NOT_OWNER409user_id not owner of mid (non-superuser)
(fallback \Throwable)dynamicResponseEnvelopeHelper::statusCodeFromThrowable()

Usage:

# Encrypted response (default)
curl -X GET https://api.gothru.co/tours/preview/{mid} \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer {token}"

# Plain response
curl -X GET https://api.gothru.co/tours/preview/{mid} \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer {token}" \
  -H "ec: false"

Notes:

  • Super-user (SUPER_USER env) bypasses ownership check — uses tour owner's user_id for link generation.
  • Preview generation orchestration lives in PreviewService; preview table queries isolated in PreviewRepository.
  • Compliance: 100% ADR.

Auth — Logout

POST /v1/auth/logout

Auth: public (no middleware)

Flow:

  1. Request enters → LogoutController@handle reads sid from request cookie via $request->cookie('sid', ''), builds LogoutDto.
  2. Controller delegates to LogoutAction::execute(LogoutDto).
  3. Action runs business logic:
    • If $dto->sid is empty string, throws MissingSessionCookieException (AUTH.MISSING_SESSION_COOKIE).
    • Calls AuthSessionRepository::deleteSessionById($dto->sid) — deletes the session row from session table.
    • Returns [].
  4. Controller receives result → expires sid cookie via setcookie('sid', '', time() - 3600, '/', '.gothru.co', true, true), wraps response:
    • Success → ResponseEnvelopeHelper::responseMessages([], 'logout_success', 200)
    • AuthDomainException → AuthExceptionHttpMapper::toStatusCode($e) → responseMessages()
    • \Throwable → ResponseEnvelopeHelper::statusCodeFromThrowable($e) → responseMessages()

DTO (app/DTOs/Auth/LogoutDto.php):

FieldTypeSourceNotes
sidstringCookie: siddefaults to '' if cookie absent; empty string triggers AUTH.MISSING_SESSION_COOKIE

Response (200):

{
  "statusCode": 200,
  "data": {
    "messages": "Logout successful"
  }
}

Set-Cookie: sid=; expires=<past>; path=/; domain=.gothru.co; Secure; HttpOnly is set on success.

Errors:

domainCodeHTTPCondition
AUTH.MISSING_SESSION_COOKIE400sid cookie absent or empty
(fallback \Throwable)dynamicResponseEnvelopeHelper::statusCodeFromThrowable()

Usage:

curl -X POST https://api.gothru.co/v1/auth/logout \
  -H "Cookie: sid={session_id}"

Notes:

  • Session deletion is idempotent — if sid does not exist in the DB, the delete no-ops and the endpoint still returns 200.
  • Cookie expiry fires only after LogoutAction succeeds (inside try block).
  • Compliance: 100% ADR. First migrated endpoint in the Auth domain.

User — Get Account Setting

GET /users/account-setting

Auth: middleware('auth') — user_id injected into request context by middleware

Flow:

  1. Request enters → GetAccountSettingController@handle builds GetAccountSettingDto from $request->all().
  2. Controller delegates to GetAccountSettingAction::execute(GetAccountSettingDto).
  3. Action runs business logic:
    • Calls UserRepository::getAccountSettingByUserId($dto->userId) — queries user_extra_data table for the authenticated user.
    • If no row found, throws UserAccountNotFoundDomainException (USER_ACCOUNT.NOT_FOUND).
    • Maps raw DB fields to a typed response array (boolean coercion for flag fields, null passthrough for timezone, logo path rewrite from /moderation/ → /profile/).
    • Returns array of account settings.
  4. Controller receives result → wraps into encrypted JSON response:
    • Success → ResponseEnvelopeHelper::encryptResult(['data' => $data], messages, 200)
    • UserAccountDomainException → UserAccountExceptionHttpMapper::toStatusCode($e) → responseMessages()
    • \Throwable → ResponseEnvelopeHelper::statusCodeFromThrowable($e) → responseMessages()

DTO (app/DTOs/User/Account/GetAccountSettingDto.php):

FieldTypeSourceNotes
userIdintrequest.user_idinjected by auth middleware; cast to int, defaults to 0 if absent

Response (200):

{
  "statusCode": 200,
  "data": {
    "messages": "Data retrieved successfully",
    "cry": "<encrypted_payload>",
    "ls": "<iv>",
    "e4": "<tag>"
  }
}

Decrypted payload shape:

{
  "data": {
    "auto_nadir": true,
    "gps": false,
    "show_info_box": true,
    "show_info_reached_limit": false,
    "show_google_msg": true,
    "show_logo_stats": false,
    "newsletter": true,
    "stats_language": "en",
    "company_logo": "/profile/logo.png",
    "timezone": "Asia/Jakarta"
  }
}

company_logo is null if no logo set. timezone is null if empty/unset.

Errors:

domainCodeHTTPCondition
USER_ACCOUNT.NOT_FOUND409No user_extra_data row found for user_id
(fallback \Throwable)dynamicResponseEnvelopeHelper::statusCodeFromThrowable()

Usage:

curl -X GET https://api.gothru.co/users/account-setting \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer {token}"

Notes:

  • Boolean fields (auto_nadir, gps, etc.) are stored as '0'/'1' strings in DB — coerced to PHP bool in Action.
  • company_logo path is rewritten: /moderation/ → /profile/ to expose the public profile URL.
  • Response is always encrypted (encryptResult) regardless of any request header.
  • Compliance: 100% ADR. Zero App\Class dependency at any layer.

Auth — Check Session

POST /v1/auth/check-session

Auth: public (no middleware — session validated manually in Action)

Flow:

  1. Request enters → CheckSessionController@handle reads sid from Cookie: sid via $request->cookie('sid', '') and ec from query/body via $request->input('ec', ''), builds CheckSessionDto.
  2. Controller delegates to CheckSessionAction::execute(CheckSessionDto).
  3. Action runs business logic:
    • Calls AuthSessionRepository::getSessionById($dto->sid) — if null, throws SessionNotFoundException (AUTH.SESSION_NOT_FOUND).
    • URL-decodes sessdata if it contains %22 (percent-encoded).
    • unserialize($sessData) and extracts $sessionData['auth'].
    • Checks expiry < time() — if expired, throws SessionExpiredException (AUTH.SESSION_EXPIRED).
    • Extracts user_id from session data, calls AuthSessionRepository::getUserById($userId) — if null, throws UserNotFoundException (AUTH.USER_NOT_FOUND).
    • If verified_email === 0, throws UserNotVerifiedException (AUTH.USER_NOT_VERIFIED).
    • If is_active === 0, throws AccountBlockedException (AUTH.ACCOUNT_BLOCKED).
    • Calls HelperClass::createToken(['email' => $user['email']]) to generate JWT — returns ['token' => string, 'sid' => string].
  4. Controller receives result → forks on ec param:
    • ec !== 'false' (default) → ResponseEnvelopeHelper::encryptResult(['token' => ..., 'sid' => ...], 'data_retrieved', 200)
    • ec === 'false' → ResponseEnvelopeHelper::responseMessages(['token' => ..., 'sid' => ...], 'data_retrieved', 200)
    • AuthDomainException → AuthExceptionHttpMapper::toStatusCode($e) → responseMessages()
    • \Throwable → ResponseEnvelopeHelper::statusCodeFromThrowable($e) → responseMessages()

DTO (app/DTOs/Auth/CheckSessionDto.php):

FieldTypeSourceNotes
sidstringCookie: siddefaults to '' if absent
ecstringquery/body ecdefaults to ''; pass "false" to get plain response

Response (200) — encrypted (default, ec omitted or ec != 'false'):

{
  "statusCode": 200,
  "data": {
    "messages": "Data retrieved successfully",
    "cry": "<encrypted payload>",
    "ls": "<iv>",
    "e4": "<tag>"
  }
}

Response (200) — plain (ec=false):

{
  "statusCode": 200,
  "data": {
    "messages": "Data retrieved successfully",
    "token": "<jwt>",
    "sid": "<session_id>"
  }
}

Errors:

domainCodeHTTPCondition
AUTH.SESSION_NOT_FOUND401sid cookie not found in session table
AUTH.SESSION_EXPIRED401session expiry timestamp < current time

Google Account — Check Google Account

GET /users/check-google-account

Auth: middleware('auth')

Flow:

  1. Request enters → CheckGoogleAccountController@handle builds CheckGoogleAccountDto from request->user_id and request->email.
  2. Controller delegates to CheckGoogleAccountAction::execute(CheckGoogleAccountDto).
  3. Action runs business logic:
    • Guard email — if empty string, throws EmailRequiredException (GOOGLE_ACCOUNT.EMAIL_REQUIRED).
    • Calls GoogleAccountRepository::findRefreshToken($userId, $email) — queries auth_publish by user_id + email; if no record, throws EmailNotFoundException (GOOGLE_ACCOUNT.EMAIL_NOT_FOUND).
    • POSTs to https://oauth2.googleapis.com/token with client_id, client_secret, refresh_token, grant_type=refresh_token.
    • If response OK: sets valid=true, message "Token is valid" — then checks scope contains streetviewpublish; if missing, flips valid=false, message "Token is valid, but streetviewpublish scope is missing".
    • If response error is invalid_grant / unauthorized_client / invalid_request: sets valid=false, message "Token is invalid".
    • Returns array{valid: bool, messages: string}.
  4. Controller receives result → wraps response:
    • Success → ResponseEnvelopeHelper::responseMessages(['valid' => $result['valid']], $result['messages'], 200)
    • GoogleAccountDomainException → GoogleAccountExceptionHttpMapper::toStatusCode($e) → responseMessages()
    • \Throwable → ResponseEnvelopeHelper::statusCodeFromThrowable($e) → responseMessages()

    "messages": "Token is valid",

  }
}

valid: false + message "Token is valid, but streetviewpublish scope is missing" — token exchange OK but scope missing. valid: false + message "Token is invalid" — token rejected by Google.

  -H "Authorization: Bearer {token}"

User — Get Account Statistic

GET /users/account-statistic

Auth: middleware('auth') — user_id injected into request context by middleware

Flow:

  1. Request enters → GetAccountStatisticController@handle builds GetAccountStatisticDto from $request->all().
  2. Controller delegates to GetAccountStatisticAction::execute(GetAccountStatisticDto).
  3. Action runs business logic:
    • If $dto->userId === 0, throws UserAccountStatisticNotFoundException (USER_ACCOUNT.STATISTIC_NOT_FOUND).
    • Checks Redis cache key app_account_stats_{userId} (TTL 3600s). On hit, returns decoded JSON directly.
    • On cache miss, calls buildStats($userId):
      • Calls AccountStatisticRepository::isAgencyAdmin($userId) — checks gothru_mod.agency.
      • If agency admin: calls getSubAgentIds($userId) → appends self → calls getPublishedToursInfoForAgency(array $ids) aggregating moderation.audit across all sub-agents + admin.
      • If regular user: calls getPublishedToursInfo($userId) aggregating moderation.audit for the user alone.
      • Calls getGothruPosition($userId) — subquery rank from moderation.audit (users with higher count + 1).
      • Calls getOverlayStatistics($userId) — conditional aggregate from hosted_tours.tours.
    • Stores result in Redis (setex, TTL 3600s).
    • Returns plain array of stats.
  4. Controller receives result → wraps into encrypted JSON response:
    • Success → ResponseEnvelopeHelper::encryptResult(['account_stats' => $accountStats], messages, 200)
    • UserAccountDomainException → UserAccountExceptionHttpMapper::toStatusCode($e) → responseMessages()
    • \Throwable → ResponseEnvelopeHelper::statusCodeFromThrowable($e) → responseMessages()

Auth — Login

POST /auth/login

Auth: public (no middleware)

Flow:

  1. Request enters → LoginController@handle builds LoginDto from $request->all().
  2. Controller delegates to LoginAction::execute(LoginDto).
  3. Action runs business logic:
    • If email or password is empty string, throws InvalidCredentialsException (AUTH.INVALID_CREDENTIALS).
    • Encodes password via AuthTokenHelper::encodePassword($dto->password).
    • Calls AuthSessionRepository::findUserByCredentials($dto->email, $encodedPassword) — matches users by user_name + password; if null, throws InvalidCredentialsException.
    • If verified_email === 0 or is_active === 0, throws AccountNotActiveException (AUTH.ACCOUNT_NOT_ACTIVE).
    • Resolves JWT TTL from hardcoded map (test accounts: 300s / 60s; all others: 2592000s / 30 days).
    • Calls AuthTokenHelper::createJwtToken(['email' => $dto->email], $ttl) to produce JWT.
    • Calls AuthSessionRepository::upsertGtToken($userId, $userName, $email) — inserts or updates auth.token_id on gothru_mod.
    • Returns ['token' => string, 'user_id' => int, 'email' => string, 'user_name' => string].
  4. Controller receives result → starts session via SessionClass: start(), register('auth', ['expiry' => time()+86400, 'user_id' => ..., 'session_id' => ...]).
  5. Controller wraps response:
    • Success → ResponseEnvelopeHelper::responseMessages(['token' => ..., 'cookie' => $session->getCookie()], 'auth.login_success', 200)
    • AuthDomainException → AuthExceptionHttpMapper::toStatusCode($e) → responseMessages()
    • \Throwable → ResponseEnvelopeHelper::statusCodeFromThrowable($e) → responseMessages()

FieldTypeSourceNotes
emailstringbody emaildefaults to ''; empty → AUTH.INVALID_CREDENTIALS
passwordstringbody passworddefaults to ''; empty → AUTH.INVALID_CREDENTIALS

Note: repository matches by users.user_name, so email field is actually the username/login identifier.

Response (200):

{
  "statusCode": 200,
  "data": {
    "messages": "Login successful",
    "token": "<jwt>",
    "cookie": "<session_cookie_value>"
  }
}

Set-Cookie: sid=<value>; ... is set by SessionClass::register() at the transport edge.

Errors:

domainCodeHTTPCondition
AUTH.INVALID_CREDENTIALS409email/password empty, or no matching user row
AUTH.ACCOUNT_NOT_ACTIVE422user verified_email === 0 or is_active === 0
(fallback \Throwable)dynamicResponseEnvelopeHelper::statusCodeFromThrowable()

Usage:

curl -X POST https://api.gothru.co/auth/login \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"email": "your_username", "password": "your_password"}'

Notes:

  • email field maps to users.user_name column — not the user's email address.
  • Session lifetime hardcoded to 86400s (24h) in LoginController::SESSION_LIFETIME.
  • SessionClass::start()/register()/getCookie() intentionally retained at Controller (transport-edge HTTP concern), same pattern as LogoutController.
  • GT token (auth.token_id) is upserted on every successful login — previous token is invalidated.
  • Compliance: ~95% ADR. SessionClass retained at transport edge (acceptable); AuthTokenHelper is a pure static helper with zero legacy dependency.
